{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
sentinel_rows = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] == -1]
print(f"Number of rows with customer_age = -1: {len(sentinel_rows)}")

# Check the distribution of channels and customer segments
print("\nChannel distribution:")
print(sales_df['channel'].value_counts())

print("\nCustomer segment distribution:")
print(sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Identify rows where customer_segment is 'new' and channel is 'paid_search'
new_paid_search = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Calculate conversion rate for new customers reached by paid search
conversion_rate = new_paid_search['converted'].mean()

# Output the result
print(f"Number of new customers reached by paid search: {len(new_paid_search)}")
print(f"Conversion rate among new customers reached by paid search: {conversion_rate}")"}
